title: Notifications
permissionBody: Stay up to date on project updates and messages.

prefs.title: Notification preferences
prefs.subtitle: Choose which updates you want to receive. Delivery stays off until push credentials are configured.

prefs.lockScreenHint: Sensitive chat or invoice content is never shown on the lock screen by default.
